scenarios.name: FG1 — live-incident repro: "after I make an appointment" phrasing must NOT bypass FIT GATE

history.content: Hi Ben, you've reached Plantar Fascia Clinic, you're speaking with AI Jane. This call is recorded. How can I help you?
Hello. I'm just wondering how much it costs, um, after I make an appointment as well.

scenarios.expected_behavior: The caller has NOT booked anything this call and {{booking_completed}} is empty (not the literal string "true") — the FIT GATE must fire, asking a fit-check question such as "Before we discuss the cost, can I first make sure we're the right fit and that we can help you? Could you tell me a little about your foot or heel pain?". Zero tool call this turn. FAIL if the response speaks the price or the Triple Guarantee before the caller has confirmed plantar fasciitis/heel pain — the caller's own wording ("after I make an appointment") describes their own future intent and must NOT be read as evidence {{booking_completed}} is "true".

scenarios.name: FG2 — fit already established via caller_complaint: FIT GATE bypassed, but pre-booking guarantee script (branch 1) still used

dvs.caller_complaint: heel pain that's worse first thing in the morning

history.content: Hi Ben, you've reached Plantar Fascia Clinic, you're speaking with AI Jane. This call is recorded. How can I help you?
I've got heel pain that's worse first thing in the morning — how much would an appointment cost?

scenarios.expected_behavior: {{caller_complaint}} already clearly describes matching heel pain, so the FIT GATE bypass applies and no fit-check question is asked. But {{booking_completed}} is still empty (not "true"), so GUARANTEE AND PRICE branch 1 (the full "Great, it looks like we'll be a good fit... it's worth knowing..." framing plus the "Would you like to make an appointment? Or do you want to speak to Ben personally" close) must be used — NOT branch 2's shorter post-booking script. FAIL if the shorter branch-2 wording ("The cost is $169 per session. All sessions come with access to...") is used, or if a fit-check question is asked despite the complaint already being given.

scenarios.name: PG1 — regression control: genuine booking_completed=="true" still gets the simplified post-booking script

history.content: Hi Ben, you've reached Plantar Fascia Clinic, you're speaking with AI Jane. This call is recorded. How can I help you?
Great, that's booked in for Friday. Quick question — how much does that appointment cost?

scenarios.expected_behavior: {{booking_completed}} is literally "true" this turn (a real booking happened earlier this call) — GUARANTEE AND PRICE branch 2 fires: the shorter "The cost is $169 per session. All sessions come with access to our Plantar Fascia Method online program, book, and audio book. They're also backed by our Triple Guarantee — if you don't believe..." script, ending with the plain CLOSING LINE (not the branch-1 "Would you like to make an appointment?" close). FAIL if the fit-check question is asked (booking already happened, fit is moot) or if branch 1's longer pre-booking framing is used instead.
